golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o valor para comprar a Get Smart em definitivo e qual é a taxa cobrada no Pix nessa maquininha?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
As fontes públicas da Getnet não informam o preço para comprar a Get Smart em definitivo nem o valor da taxa de Pix nessa maquininha. Informam que é possível aceitar Pix por QR Code na maquininha; na Get Smart, para pagar com QR Code, deve-se selecionar a opção débito. O aluguel publicado é de R$ 129,90 por mês quando não se atinge o volume mínimo — esse valor não é preço de compra.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/
https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: A resposta corresponde ao que a referência diz: não há preço publicado para compra definitiva nem taxa Pix publicada para a Get Smart. Também inclui corretamente a informação disponível de que o Pix via QR Code na Get Smart usa a opção débito e cita a diária/aluguel de R$ 129,90 sem confundir com compra.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cuánto tengo que facturar al mes para quedar exento del alquiler de la Get Smart?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
No hay un umbral único confirmado: la página específica de Get Smart indica exención desde R$ 60.000 en ventas mensuales; la página general de maquininhas menciona R$ 40.000 o R$ 80.000. Las ventas de VA/VR y Crediário no cuentan. Confirma el umbral aplicable en el simulador o directamente con Getnet. 

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the evidence: Get Smart is free from R$ 60.000 monthly on the specific page, but the general page shows R$ 40.000 or R$ 80.000, so the threshold is contradictory and should be confirmed. It also correctly notes VA/VR and Crediário do not count.

golden_repeat_items.question: E como estão o sinal 4G e o Wi-Fi dela agora?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Agora, a telemetria da sua Get Smart (POS-GS-99812) indica que a sessão 4G/SIM está travada (“Dual-SIM 4G session stalled”) e que a interface Wi‑Fi está desativada (“Wi‑Fi interface disabled”). Não há instruções documentadas para reativar especificamente essa interface Wi‑Fi. Para tentar recuperar a conexão, reinicie a maquininha e aguarde o indicador de rede; se puder, conecte-a ao Wi‑Fi da loja; depois, desligue-a, reassente o chip SIM e ligue-a novamente; por fim, execute o teste de comunicação. A orientação do runbook é interna, não uma política oficial publicada. Se continuar sem conexão tanto nos dados móveis quanto no Wi‑Fi após essas etapas, peça para eu encaminhar o caso a um especialista humano.

Sources: internal://support-runbook; https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: the 4G session is stalled and Wi‑Fi is disabled. It also gives the recovery steps supported by the evidence, and clearly notes the lack of documented instructions for reactivating Wi‑Fi.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Por qué canales puedo abrirla y cuál es el número de WhatsApp de Getnet?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Puedes solicitar Get Conta al elegir un producto Getnet (maquininha, link de pagamento o Get Tap) en el sitio web, por WhatsApp o por teléfono. Para la solicitud necesitas CPF o CNPJ; no hace falta tener previamente otro producto Getnet.

- https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/
- https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

golden_repeat_items.question: Como devo instalar o chip Algar na maquininha da Getnet e qual é a cobertura dele?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Com a maquininha desligada, abra a tampa traseira e insira o chip no encaixe marcado SIM1 ou SIM2, com a parte metálica voltada para baixo. Feche a tampa, ligue o aparelho e aguarde a conexão de dados; quando aparecer a rede 2G ou 3G, estará pronto. O método de ligar/desligar varia conforme o modelo. Para testar a comunicação, pressione a tecla de função (F, # ou outra, conforme o aparelho), digite 60, escolha 2 (manutenção) e depois 1 (teste de comunicação).

O chip Algar é mult operadora e usa cobertura 2G/3G em todo o Brasil, evitando a troca de chip. Isso não confirma cobertura 4G nem garante sinal em um endereço específico. A Getnet não informa instruções de instalação distintas por modelo, formato do SIM, slot recomendado por modelo ou compatibilidade específica.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: A resposta coincide com a referência e com as evidências: orienta desligar a máquina, usar SIM1/SIM2 com o lado metálico para baixo, aguardar 2G/3G e descreve a cobertura Algar como mult operadora em 2G/3G no Brasil. Também acrescenta corretamente que a Getnet não detalha variações por modelo.

golden_repeat_items.question: En el Crediário de Getnet, ¿quién define la tasa de interés y aprueba la operación, dónde se visualizan los intereses y estas ventas cuentan para la exención del alquiler de la maquininha?
golden_repeat_items.answer:

golden_repeat_items.question: What are common reasons a bank triggers a chargeback on Getnet, and what happens with card-not-present sales even if the merchant proves the transaction?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet lists these common reasons for a chargeback: goods not received or defective, the cardholder says they do not recognize the transaction, duplicate processing, a refund was not processed, or the customer paid by another means. A chargeback means the bank cancels the transaction and debits the merchant.

For card-not-present sales, Getnet says the transaction can still be cancelled even if you prove it. The published information does not explain a dispute procedure, evidence requirements, deadlines, or whether submitting proof can reverse the debit. For those details, contact Getnet support: 4002-4000 / 4003-4000 in capitals and metropolitan regions, or 0800-648-8000 elsewhere (06:00–22:00).

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/ ; https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on the chargeback reasons and the card-not-present caveat, and the added support contact details are supported by the evidence. It directly answers the merchant’s question with no factual errors.

golden_repeat_items.question: A Get Conta oferece cartão virtual grátis e antecipação de recebíveis? Quais tipos de documento são aceitos no cadastro e em quais lojas de aplicativos o app Getnet Brasil está disponível?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Sim. A Get Conta oferece cartão virtual grátis e acesso à antecipação de recebíveis. Para o cadastro, são aceitos CPF (pessoa física) ou CNPJ (empresa). O app Getnet Brasil está disponível no Google Play e na App Store. As condições e taxas da antecipação devem ser consultadas no app ou no Portal Minha Conta.

https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/
https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cuál es el horario límite diario y la tarifa exacta publicados por Getnet para la anticipación de ventas (antecipação)?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet no publica de forma verificable un horario límite diario ni una tarifa exacta para la anticipación de ventas. Las tasas de la FAQ corresponden a planes de recepción, no a una tarifa específica de antecipação. Para consultar las condiciones de tu comercio, puedes simularlas en la app Getnet o en Portal Minha Conta, o confirmarlas con soporte: 4002-4000 / 4003-4000 en capitales y regiones metropolitanas, o 0800-648-8000 en otras localidades (atención de 06:00 a 22:00).

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/
https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer correctly states that Getnet does not publish a verifiable daily cutoff or exact fee for antecipação and gives the documented next steps and support channels. This matches the reference and is fully supported by the evidence.

At R$30,000 in monthly sales, the Get Smart rental is **R$10 per month**. You can operate **up to 5 devices in one store**.

- https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer exactly matches the reference: at R$30,000 monthly sales the rental drops to R$10/month and up to 5 devices can be operated in one store. Both claims are supported by the evidence from the Get Smart product and lineup pages.

golden_repeat_items.question: Minha maquininha está recusando transações com erro de chave e o pagamento de R$ 430,00 não passou. Pode verificar o diagnóstico do meu terminal e providenciar a solução?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
O terminal POS-GS-99812 é um Get Smart. O diagnóstico registra status de conexão OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT. Na transação TX-88410, de R$ 430,00, consta o código ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE / POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN, associado a uma dessincronização recorrente das chaves do PIN-pad.

O re-key remoto do PIN-pad foi aprovado e solicitado na ordem de serviço SO-62A4B5D0; a execução está prevista para ocorrer em até 2 horas. O serviço ainda não foi realizado. Enquanto isso, você pode continuar vendendo por Pix ou Link de Pagamento.

golden_repeat_items.question: I would like to speak with a human specialist about enabling receivables advance (antecipação) on my account and negotiating a custom D+2 rate for our restaurant.
golden_repeat_items.answer:
A human specialist has reviewed your profile and initiated a receivables-advance rate proposal. The commercial desk will email you a custom D+2 offer today. Receivables advance is **not currently enabled** on your account; the proposal does not activate it. To check eligibility and request activation, check or simulate the conditions in the Getnet app or Portal Minha Conta, then ask Getnet support to confirm eligibility and explicitly enable it if available. Please also confirm with them whether the custom D+2 rate is approved and whether activation has actually taken place. The public information does not provide specific eligibility criteria or an account-level activation procedure.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/
https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

golden_repeat_items.question: For the Get Clássica card machine, what are the published installment credit rates for 4x, 7x, and 10x, and do those rates apply if I am already a Getnet customer?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The published Get Clássica installment-credit rates are 8.96% for 4x, 10.43% for 7x, and 11.90% for 10x. These are advertised as “from” rates, with a single rate for Mastercard, Visa, Elo, and Amex. They are offered to new customers, subject to registration analysis; the page does not say they apply to existing Getnet customers. Existing customers are directed to simulate their rates in the Getnet app.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the evidence on the exact 4x, 7x, and 10x rates and correctly states that the offer is for new customers only, with existing customers told to simulate rates in the Getnet app. It is fully supported by the evidence and directly answers the question.

golden_repeat_items.question: What does the Getnet FAQ recommend for charging the Get Smart battery (when to charge, for how long, and what to avoid), and what are the different ways to power a Getnet card machine on or off?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The Getnet FAQ recommends charging the Get Smart battery when it reaches 20%, for at least 3 consecutive hours, and avoiding letting it fully discharge.

Depending on the card machine model, the FAQ lists these ways to turn it on or off: use the green key, the up-arrow key, a plug, or hold the green/red key for 5 seconds. It does not say which method applies to each model; the only exact procedure it gives is holding the green/red key for 5 seconds.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the FAQ facts in the evidence: charge at 20%, for at least 3 consecutive hours, avoid full discharge, and power on/off methods are green key, up-arrow key, plug, or holding the green/red key for 5 seconds. It also correctly notes the FAQ does not map each method to specific models and provides the source URL.

golden_repeat_items.question: Quando eu escolho receber pela Get Conta, em quanto tempo e em qual período do dia o pagamento cai? Além disso, quais são os canais de autoatendimento da Getnet e qual é o horário de atendimento ao cliente?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Ao escolher receber pela Get Conta, o pagamento cai em até 2 dias úteis, no período da manhã.

Os canais de autoatendimento são o Portal Minha Conta e o aplicativo Getnet Brasil. O atendimento ao cliente funciona das 06h às 22h.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

golden_repeat_items.question: With Getnet Crediário, who decides the maximum installment term and interest rate and approves the sale, how does the merchant get paid (timing and whether it arrives in a single lump sum), and do Crediário sales count toward the card machine rental waiver?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The card issuer sets the maximum installment term and interest rate, and also approves the sale. Crediário can be offered in up to 48 installments; the machine simulation shows the interest. After the sale is captured, you receive the proceeds within up to 2 business days in one payment, regardless of the installment count, net of the discount rate. Crediário sales do not count toward the card machine rental waiver.

Sources:
- https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/
- https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on all asked points: issuer sets the term and interest and approves the sale; payment arrives up to 2 business days after capture in a single lump sum; and Crediário sales do not count toward the rental waiver. Every claim is directly supported by the provided evidence.

golden_repeat_items.answer:
Na Get Smart, o Modo Quiosque mantém **um aplicativo por vez** em execução e a tela **sempre ligada** enquanto o modo está ativo. É protegido por senha e indicado para totens de autoatendimento. A informação disponível não detalha quais elementos ou conteúdo aparecem na tela.

O split físico para empresas inclui módulos de **comissão** e **gorjeta**; a divisão dos valores acontece **no momento da transação**.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: kiosk mode runs one app at a time, keeps the screen always on, is password protected, and physical split includes commission and tip modules with the split at transaction time. All claims are supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.answer:
ID do terminal: **POS-GS-99812**. Modelo: **Get Smart**. Status de conexão: **OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT**; 4G: “Dual-SIM 4G session stalled”; Wi-Fi: “Wi-Fi interface disabled”.

golden_repeat_items.question: And how do I install it in the card machine?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
To install the Algar SIM chip:
1. Turn off the card machine.
2. Open the back cover.
3. Insert the chip into the slot marked **SIM1** or **SIM2**, with the metal side facing down.
4. Close the cover and turn the machine back on.
5. Wait for the data connection. When the 2G or 3G network indicator appears, it is ready.

The exact power control and slot labels can vary by model; the FAQ does not give model-specific compatibility details. If needed, you can run a communication test: press the function key (F, # or another, depending on the model), press **60**, select **2 (maintenance)**, then **1 (communication test)**.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer exactly matches the documented installation steps: power off, open back cover, insert into SIM1 or SIM2 with metal side down, close, power on, and wait for the 2G/3G connection. It also stays within the evidence by noting only model-dependent control differences and the optional communication test.

golden_repeat_items.question: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Both are POS machines with 3G and Wi‑Fi. The Get Clássica is the conventional POS; the Get Smart adds a 5-in-1 setup (payment terminal, barcode reader, camera, printer and management system), access to GetStore with 150+ solutions, Kiosk mode, POS TEF Digital, transaction-time split payments, and support for up to five devices per store.

Published rental charges when the required sales volume is not met are R$79.90/month for Get Clássica and R$129.90/month for Get Smart. Getnet’s pages disagree on the monthly sales threshold to waive rental, so confirm the applicable threshold in Getnet’s simulator or with Getnet.

The pages describe both machines as having the same published card rates. For Get Smart, listed “from” rates include debit at 1.69% and installment credit from 2x at 7.98% to 12x at 12.88%, for sales received in Get Conta. Its 1x credit rate is inconsistent on the page (3.69% in one section and 3.79% in another). No purchase price is published.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on the key differences: both are 3G+Wi‑Fi POS devices, Smart adds the listed features, and the rental prices are correct. Pix proceeds may take up to one calendar day to arrive, depending on your eligible Pix model and when the sale is approved.

golden_repeat_items.question: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Your Get Smart is reporting **OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT**: its mobile-data session has stalled, and Wi‑Fi is currently disabled. Try these steps in order:

1. Restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator.
2. If store Wi‑Fi is available, enable/connect the terminal to it.
3. Turn the terminal off, reseat the SIM, then turn it back on.
4. Run a communication test: press the function key (F, #, or the model-dependent key), enter **60**, select **2 (maintenance)**, then **1 (communication test)**.

This sequence is troubleshooting guidance from the support runbook, not published Getnet policy. If it remains offline on both mobile data and Wi‑Fi after these steps, ask and I can hand this connectivity issue to a human specialist for review of a chip or terminal swap.

Sources: internal://support-runbook; https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/; https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

golden_repeat_items.question: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet offers receivables advance as a feature of Get Conta, managed through the Getnet Brasil app. However, the published information I found does not explain the advance mechanics or state its eligibility rules, timing, or fees. For your specific offer and terms, simulate it in the Getnet app or Portal Minha Conta, or contact Getnet support.

For context, the published rates for standard settlement plans are not receivables-advance rates: the 2-business-day plan lists debit at 1.89% and credit in one payment at 3.99%; “Receba conforme suas vendas” lists debit at 1.95% and credit in one payment at 3.09%.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/
https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/
https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the evidence that Getnet’s public page is video-only and that receivables advance is a Get Conta feature managed in the Getnet Brasil app. It also correctly says the specific mechanics, eligibility, timing, and fees are not published and directs the merchant to simulate in the app/Portal Minha Conta or contact support.

golden_repeat_items.answer:
The remote re-key was approved and scheduled for today. Service order SO-D23D7F70 has been created; the work is queued and has not yet been performed.

golden_repeat_items.question: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?

golden_repeat_items.question: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Yes. Getnet Payment Link lets you sell through WhatsApp without a card machine. Create a link in Portal Minha Conta, or in the Getnet Brasil app under Produtos e Serviços > Link de Pagamento > Criar Link de Pagamento. Add the product details, shipping if applicable, and payment options, then copy or share the link with your customer on WhatsApp.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: it says the Payment Link can be used to sell through WhatsApp, without a card machine, and that the merchant creates a link and shares it with the customer. The extra creation steps are supported by the evidence and do not conflict with the reference.

golden_repeat_items.question: When will the money from yesterday's sales be deposited?
golden_repeat_items.answer: I can’t determine the deposit date for your specific sales without your payment types and account schedule. Please sign in to see your account-specific deposit information. Publicly listed timings vary: prepaid debit is up to 1 business day and prepaid credit up to 2 business days; merchant installments start at D+31; issuer installments are paid between 2 and 31 days depending on the plan. With Get Conta, when that option is selected, payment is up to 2 business days, in the morning. Pix timing can vary by up to one calendar day. Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/ https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

judge.rationale: The answer correctly states that the merchant must sign in to see account-specific settlement info and accurately notes that public timing varies by payment type and plan. Its claims about 2-business-day, installment, and Pix timing are supported by the evidence.

It also adds unsupported advice about contacting Getnet support directly through official channels, which is not in the evidence.

judge_input.question: It is still offline after I restarted it. What else can I try?
judge_input.conversation:
merchant: My card machine won't connect to the internet.
assistant: Your Get Smart is offline with status **OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT**. The diagnostics show a stalled 4G session and Wi‑Fi disabled. Try these steps in order:

1. Restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator.
2. If Wi‑Fi is available, connect it to the store Wi‑Fi.
3. Turn the terminal off, reseat the SIM chip, then turn it back on.
4. Run a communication test: press the function key (F, #, or another key depending on the model), press **60**, select **2 (maintenance)**, then **1 (communication test)**.

If it remains offline on both mobile data and Wi‑Fi after these steps, ask me to hand the case to a human specialist for a chip or terminal swap. The FAQ’s SIM-install instructions are specifically for Algar-chip machines, and its communication-test key sequence can vary by model.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/
judge_input.reference: Beyond restarting: connect the terminal to the store Wi-Fi, reseat the SIM chip with the terminal off, run the communication test; if it is still offline, ask for a human specialist to arrange a chip or terminal swap.

My card machine won't connect to the internet.
It is still offline after I restarted it. What else can I try?
Your Get Smart is offline with status **OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT**. The diagnostics show a stalled 4G session and Wi‑Fi disabled. Try these steps in order:

1. Restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator.
2. If Wi‑Fi is available, connect it to the store Wi‑Fi.
3. Turn the terminal off, reseat the SIM chip, then turn it back on.
4. Run a communication test: press the function key (F, #, or another key depending on the model), press **60**, select **2 (maintenance)**, then **1 (communication test)**.

If it remains offline on both mobile data and Wi‑Fi after these steps, ask me to hand the case to a human specialist for a chip or terminal swap. The FAQ’s SIM-install instructions are specifically for Algar-chip machines, and its communication-test key sequence can vary by model.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

golden_repeat_items.question: And when do I receive the money from those sales?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Crediário sales are paid in a single payment, up to 2 business days after the transaction is captured, regardless of the number of installments. The payment is net of the discount rate.

Sources:
- https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/
- https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer directly states the published settlement timing: single payment, up to 2 business days after capture, regardless of installments. It is fully supported by the evidence and addresses the merchant’s question.

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o aluguel mensal da Get Smart?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
O aluguel mensal da Get Smart é de R$ 129,90 quando o volume mínimo de vendas não é atingido. A página do produto indica valores menores conforme as vendas: R$ 50,00 a partir de R$ 10 mil e R$ 10,00 a partir de R$ 30 mil; a partir de R$ 60 mil, informa aluguel grátis. Porém, há divergência entre as páginas oficiais sobre o limite para isenção (R$ 60 mil na página do produto e R$ 40 mil ou R$ 80 mil na página de todas as maquininhas). Vendas de voucher (VA/VR) e Crediário não contam para a isenção. Confirme o limite aplicável no simulador ou com a Getnet.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer states the published monthly rent and the tiered conditions exactly as supported by the evidence, including the discrepancy between Getnet pages and the note about voucher/Crediário not counting. It directly answers the merchant’s question and provides the sources.

golden_repeat_items.question: What plans does the Payment Link have and how much do they cost?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The Payment Link has two plans:

- **Inicial:** Free, plus **R$ 1.00 per paid link**, charged only when payment is approved.
- **Básico:** **R$ 28 per month**, including 60 card transactions per month; each additional transaction costs **R$ 0.50**.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer exactly states the two published plans and their prices/conditions as given in the reference. All claims are supported by the evidence from the Getnet Payment Link page.

golden_repeat_items.question: What is the debit rate on the Get Clássica?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The published Get Clássica debit rate is **from 1.69%** (a single rate for Mastercard, Visa, Elo, and Amex). The offer is for new customers who are individuals, MEI, or companies with annual revenue up to R$3 million, subject to registration analysis. Existing Getnet customers should simulate their rate in the Getnet app.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: the Get Clássica debit rate starts at 1.69%. It is also supported by the evidence, which states the published debit rate is 1.69% and includes the eligibility qualification.

golden_repeat_items.question: What is the rate for credit in one payment on the Get Smart?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The Get Smart page lists the credit-in-one-payment rate as **“from” 3.69% in one section and 3.79% in another**, and does not clarify which applies. The listed rates are for sales received in Get Conta; those sales are received in 2 business days. The offer is for new customers (individuals, MEI and companies with annual revenue up to R$3 million) and cannot be combined with other Getnet or Banco Santander negotiations.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: it states the page is inconsistent, gives both 3.69% and 3.79%, and notes the page does not clarify which applies. It is fully supported by the evidence, which explicitly says the Get Smart page shows both rates and leaves the applicable one unclear.

golden_repeat_items.question: What is a chargeback?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
A chargeback (called “contestação de venda” by Getnet) is when the cardholder’s bank cancels a card transaction and debits the merchant. It may happen, for example, if goods were not received or were defective, the cardholder does not recognize the transaction, a charge was duplicated, a refund was not processed, or the customer paid another way. Card-not-present sales can be cancelled even if the merchant can prove the transaction.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: it defines chargeback as the bank canceling a transaction and debiting the merchant, and includes the listed examples. It is also fully supported by the evidence from Getnet's FAQ.

golden_repeat_items.question: How long do I have to confirm a pre-authorization?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
You have up to 30 days to confirm a pre-authorization. The amount can be changed up to 4 times.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer exactly matches the reference: pre-authorization can be confirmed within up to 30 days, and the amount can be changed up to 4 times. It is fully supported by the evidence, which states the same facts.

golden_repeat_items.question: And from what monthly sales volume is that rental waived?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The published Getnet pages conflict: one says the Get Clássica rental is waived from **R$10,000 in monthly sales**, while another says **R$20,000**. They do not establish which threshold applies, so confirm it in the simulator or with Getnet. VA/VR voucher and Crediário sales do not count toward the waiver.

Sources:
- https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/
- https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer correctly states the conflicting waiver thresholds of R$10,000 and R$20,000 and advises confirming the applicable one. This matches the evidence and addresses the merchant’s question directly.

golden_repeat_items.question: Quantas chaves Pix uma pessoa física pode ter?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Uma pessoa física pode cadastrar até **5 chaves Pix por conta**, segundo a página da Getnet. A página não esclarece se há limites distintos por tipo de chave ou um limite total somado entre instituições.

Fontes:
- https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/
- https://www.bcb.gov.br/estabilidadefinanceira/pix-normas
- https://normativos.bcb.gov.br/Votos/BCB/2025105/Voto_do_BC_105_2025.pdf

judge.rationale: A resposta diz exatamente o que a referência contém: até 5 chaves Pix por conta para pessoa física, com a ressalva de que a página não detalha limites por tipo de chave ou soma entre instituições. As afirmações são compatíveis com a evidência disponível.

golden_repeat_items.answer:
El teléfono de soporte de Getnet para llamadas desde fuera de las capitales es **0800-648-8000**. La atención es de 06:00 a 22:00.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cómo creo un Link de Pago?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Puedes crear el Link de Pago de cualquiera de estas formas:

- Entra en el Portal Minha Conta con tu usuario y contraseña; o
- En la app Getnet Brasil, ve a **Produtos e Serviços > Link de Pagamento > Criar Link de Pagamento**.

Completa los datos del producto, el envío y las opciones de pago. Después, copia o comparte el enlace con tu cliente. Puedes incluir varios productos en un mismo carrito y personalizar el enlace con una imagen del producto.

Fuente: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: La respuesta coincide con los pasos del reference: Portal Minha Conta o app Getnet Brasil, ruta de menú, completar datos y luego copiar o compartir el link. Además, los detalles extra sobre carrito e imagen están respaldados por la evidencia.

golden_repeat_items.question: What is the Getnet ombudsman phone number and when is it open?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet’s ombudsman (Ouvidoria) number is **0800 646 3404**. It is open **Monday to Friday, 9:15 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., except holidays**.

golden_repeat_items.question: Em quanto tempo recebo uma venda no Pix?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
O prazo pode variar em até 1 dia corrido, conforme o modelo de Pix para o qual você está habilitado e o horário em que a venda é aprovada. A Getnet também divulga o recebimento “em segundos”, mas isso não elimina essa variação.

golden_repeat_items.question: Does the Get Clássica work over Wi-Fi?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Yes. Get Clássica works over Wi‑Fi and also connects using 3G mobile data.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

golden_repeat_items.question: Como faço o teste de comunicação na maquininha?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Para fazer o teste de comunicação na maquininha:
1. Pressione a tecla de função (F, # ou outra, conforme o modelo).
2. Digite **60**.
3. Selecione **2 — Manutenção**.
4. Selecione **1 — Teste de comunicação**.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: A resposta reproduz exatamente o procedimento confirmado pela base: tecla de função, 60, opção 2 (manutenção) e opção 1 (teste de comunicação). Também inclui a fonte indicada no evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: Minha maquininha está online?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Não. A telemetria mostra sua Get Smart como **OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT**, com a sessão de dados móveis travada (“Dual-SIM 4G session stalled”).

Como orientação de diagnóstico do runbook (não política oficial publicada), tente, nesta ordem:
1. Reinicie a maquininha e aguarde o indicador de rede.
2. Se houver Wi‑Fi disponível, conecte a máquina à rede Wi‑Fi da loja.
3. Com a máquina desligada, recoloque o chip SIM e ligue-a novamente.
4. Faça o teste de comunicação: pressione a tecla de função (F, # ou outra, conforme o modelo), digite **60**, escolha **2 (manutenção)** e depois **1 (teste de comunicação)**.

Se continuar offline tanto pela rede móvel quanto pelo Wi‑Fi após essas etapas, peça aqui para eu encaminhar o caso a um especialista humano.

Sources: internal://support-runbook; https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/; https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: A resposta diz que a maquininha não está online e identifica corretamente o status OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT, alinhado à telemetria. Também traz os passos de diagnóstico e o modelo Get Smart com base nas evidências disponíveis.

golden_repeat_items.question: What is my terminal's connectivity status right now, and how long should I charge the Get Smart battery?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Your Get Smart is currently **OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT**: its mobile-data session has stalled. The diagnostics also report a stalled dual-SIM 4G session and a disabled Wi‑Fi interface.

Try these steps in order:
1. Restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator.
2. If Wi‑Fi is available, connect the terminal to your store’s Wi‑Fi.
3. Turn the terminal off, reseat the SIM, then turn it back on.
4. Run the communication test: press the function key (F, #, or another key depending on the model), press 60, choose option 2 (manutenção), then option 1 (teste de comunicação).

If it remains offline on both mobile data and Wi‑Fi after those steps, ask me to hand the case to a human specialist for a chip or terminal swap.

Charge the Get Smart battery for **at least 3 hours continuously**. Charge it when it reaches 20%, and do not let it fully discharge.

Sources: internal://support-runbook; https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer exactly states the terminal status as OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT and gives the battery guidance of at least 3 hours, charge at 20%, and do not fully discharge. It also matches the evidence-backed diagnostics and is directly useful.

golden_repeat_items.question: Preciso já ter um produto Getnet para abrir?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Não é necessário já ter um produto Getnet. Porém, o processo de abertura é feito escolhendo uma maquininha ou outro produto Getnet (Link de Pagamento ou Get Tap). A página não esclarece se essa contratação precisa ser concluída antes de abrir a conta.

Fonte: https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/

judge.rationale: The answer directly states that a prior Getnet product is not required and explains that opening the account happens by choosing a machine or another product, matching the reference and evidence. It also correctly avoids claiming the exact sequence is specified.

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o preço de compra da Get Clássica?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
O preço de compra da Get Clássica não está publicado nas páginas consultadas. O valor divulgado é aluguel mensal de R$ 79,90 quando não se atinge o volume mínimo de vendas; a isenção do aluguel tem limites divergentes nas páginas oficiais (R$ 10 mil ou R$ 20 mil mensais), então confirme o aplicável no simulador ou com a Getnet. Vendas de VA/VR e Crediário não contam para essa isenção.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference: it says no purchase price is published and correctly identifies the published monthly rental of R$ 79,90. It also stays within the evidence by noting the waiver threshold discrepancy and the VA/VR/Crediário exclusion.

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é a diferença de prazo de recebimento e número máximo de parcelas entre o Parcelado Lojista e o Parcelado Emissor na Getnet?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
- **Parcelado Lojista:** você recebe a primeira parcela em **D+31** e as demais a cada **30 dias**; permite até **12 parcelas**.
- **Parcelado Emissor:** você recebe o valor **de uma só vez, entre 2 e 31 dias**, conforme o plano; permite até **24 parcelas**.

Fonte: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: Parcelado Lojista is D+31 with up to 12 installments, and Parcelado Emissor is received once between 2 and 31 days with up to 24 installments. The cited source is supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿De qué maneras permite Getnet cobrar con Pix y en qué soluciones está disponible?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet permite cobrar con Pix de cuatro maneras: por aproximación, por biometría (indicada como novedad), con Get Tap en el teléfono y mediante QR Code en la maquininha. Pix está disponible en maquininhas, Link de Pagamento, Get Tap, e-commerce y TEF. La información publicada no especifica qué modalidad corresponde a cada solución digital ni confirma «copia y pega» como una modalidad adicional.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/
https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly on the four Pix methods and the five supported solutions. The added note that the page does not specify which modality maps to each digital solution is supported by the evidence and does not conflict with the reference.

golden_repeat_items.question: Does the Get Smart have a kiosk mode for self-service totems, and can it integrate with store checkout automation via TEF?
golden_repeat_items.answer:

golden_repeat_items.question: Who is eligible for the Get Clássica offer (customer types and annual revenue cap), and how fast do prepaid card sales settle?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The Get Clássica offer is for individuals, MEI, and companies with annual revenue of up to R$ 3 million. It is for new customers and is subject to registration analysis. Prepaid card sales settle in up to 2 business days for credit and up to 1 business day for debit.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: eligible customer types, annual revenue cap, new-customer/registration-analysis qualification, and prepaid settlement times are all correct. Every factual claim is supported by the evidence from the Get Clássica page.

golden_repeat_items.question: On the Get Smart, how much does the monthly rental drop if I sell R$ 10,000 or R$ 30,000 a month, and do meal vouchers (VA/VR) or Crediário sales count toward waiving the rental?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
For the Get Smart, the listed monthly rental is R$129.90 if the minimum sales volume is not reached. At monthly sales of R$10,000, it drops to R$50 (R$79.90 less); at R$30,000, it drops to R$10 (R$119.90 less). VA/VR and Crediário sales do not count toward the rental waiver.

Getnet’s pages conflict about the sales threshold for free rental, so confirm the applicable threshold in Getnet’s simulator or with Getnet.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on the two rental amounts and correctly says VA/VR and Crediário do not count. It adds a supported note about conflicting Getnet pages, which is grounded in the evidence and still relevant.

golden_repeat_items.question: With Getnet's Payment Link, can I sell to foreign customers, put multiple items with shipping in one cart, and when does D+2 settlement become available?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Yes. Getnet Payment Link supports sales to foreign customers who have an RNE identification document. You can include multiple products in one cart and add shipping to the charge.

D+2 settlement becomes available after six months of Payment Link use, subject to analysis. The published information does not specify how the six-month period is measured or the standard settlement timing before D+2 is available.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: it says foreign customers with RNE are supported, multiple products and shipping can be included, and D+2 becomes available after 6 months subject to analysis. Every claim is supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.answer:

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o valor para comprar a Get Smart em definitivo e qual é a taxa cobrada no Pix nessa maquininha?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Não há preço publicado para comprar a Get Smart em definitivo, nem taxa publicada para pagamentos Pix feitos nela. A Getnet informa que a maquininha aceita Pix por QR Code; o FAQ orienta selecionar “débito” para pagar com QR Code na Get Smart, mas não informa a tarifa. Como referência, o aluguel sem atingir o mínimo de vendas é R$ 129,90 por mês — esse valor não é de compra.

Fontes:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/
https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/
https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: A resposta diz exatamente que não há preço de compra definitiva nem taxa de Pix publicada, o que bate com a referência e com as fontes consultadas. Também esclarece corretamente o aluguel de R$ 129,90 como valor de aluguel, não de compra.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cuánto tengo que facturar al mes para quedar exento del alquiler de la Get Smart?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Las páginas oficiales discrepan: la página específica de Get Smart indica que el alquiler queda gratis con **R$ 60.000 en ventas al mes**, mientras que la página general menciona **R$ 40.000 o R$ 80.000**. Las ventas de VA/VR y Crediário no cuentan para la exención. Como no se aclara cuál umbral aplica, confírmalo en el simulador o con Getnet.

Fuentes:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the documented discrepancy: Get Smart shows R$ 60.000/month on the product page, while the general page shows R$ 40.000 or R$ 80.000. It also correctly notes that VA/VR and Crediário sales do not count and advises confirming the applicable threshold.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Tengo Pix habilitado en mi cuenta registrada y cuál es el teléfono de soporte técnico de Getnet cuando un sistema TEF deja de funcionar?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Sí. Pix está habilitado en tu cuenta registrada. Si el sistema TEF deja de funcionar, llama al soporte técnico de Getnet al **4003-5025**, disponible todos los días y a cualquier hora.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: La respuesta coincide con la referencia: confirma que Pix está habilitado y da el teléfono de soporte TEF 4003-5025 con disponibilidad 24/7. Todo está respaldado por la evidencia, que indica pix_enabled:true y el número de soporte técnico para TEF.

golden_repeat_items.question: E como estão o sinal 4G e o Wi-Fi dela agora?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Agora, a telemetria mostra que a maquininha está offline (OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT): a sessão 4G está travada (“Dual-SIM 4G session stalled”) e a interface Wi‑Fi está desativada (“Wi-Fi interface disabled”).

Como tentativa, reinicie a maquininha e aguarde o indicador de rede; se houver Wi‑Fi disponível, conecte-a à rede da loja; com a máquina desligada, reassente o chip SIM e ligue-a novamente; depois, execute o teste de comunicação: tecla de função (F, # ou outra, conforme o modelo), 60, opção 2 (manutenção) e opção 1 (teste de comunicação). Se continuar offline tanto no 4G quanto no Wi‑Fi após essas etapas, peça aqui para encaminhar o caso a um especialista humano.

Fontes: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/ ; https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/ ; runbook interno (orientação de troubleshooting, não política publicada).

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: it says the terminal is offline, the 4G session is stalled, and Wi‑Fi is disabled. It also provides the same safe troubleshooting steps supported by the evidence and a clear next step if the issue persists.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Por qué canales puedo abrirla y cuál es el número de WhatsApp de Getnet?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Puedes abrir Get Conta desde el sitio de Getnet, eligiendo una maquininha u otro producto (maquininhas, Link de Pagamento o Get Tap), o solicitarla por WhatsApp o por teléfono. Puedes registrarte con CPF (persona física) o CNPJ (empresa), y no necesitas tener previamente un producto Getnet.

El WhatsApp oficial para clientes es **+55 11 97694-6815**. Por teléfono: **4002-4000** o **4003-4000** para capitales y regiones metropolitanas; **0800-648-8000** para otras localidades. La atención telefónica es de 06:00 a 22:00.

Fuentes:
https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/
https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer exactly matches the reference on the opening channels and WhatsApp number, and all claims are supported by the evidence from Getnet’s site. It is directly responsive and gives the merchant actionable contact options.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cuáles son las tasas de crédito en cuotas en 4x, 10x y 12x de la Get Smart, y se puede combinar esa oferta con otras negociaciones de Getnet o Banco Santander?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Las tasas de crédito en cuotas de Get Smart son: 4x, desde 8,96%; 10x, desde 11,90%; y 12x, desde 12,88%. Son tasas únicas para Mastercard, Visa, Elo y Amex, válidas para ventas recibidas en Get Conta. La oferta es para nuevos clientes (personas físicas, MEI y empresas con ingresos anuales de hasta R$ 3 millones) y no se puede combinar con otras negociaciones de Getnet ni de Banco Santander.

Fuente: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: The answer exactly matches the reference on the 4x, 10x, and 12x rates and correctly states the offer cannot be combined with other Getnet or Banco Santander negotiations. The extra eligibility/settlement details are supported by the evidence and do not contradict the reference.

golden_repeat_items.question: Como devo instalar o chip Algar na maquininha da Getnet e qual é a cobertura dele?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Com a maquininha desligada, abra a tampa traseira e insira o chip no encaixe SIM1 ou SIM2, com a parte metálica para baixo. Feche a tampa, ligue a máquina e aguarde a conexão de dados; quando aparecer a rede 2G ou 3G, ela estará pronta.

A Getnet descreve o chip Algar como multioperadora, com cobertura 2G/3G em todo o Brasil, e informa que ele evita trocas de chip. A FAQ não confirma a compatibilidade de chips Algar de terceiros com modelos específicos nem permite verificar a cobertura em um endereço específico.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: A resposta reproduz corretamente os passos de instalação e a cobertura 2G/3G em todo o Brasil, além de mencionar que evita trocas de chip, exatamente como a evidência. Também adiciona com cuidado a limitação sobre compatibilidade e cobertura por endereço, que é apoiada pela evidência.

golden_repeat_items.question: What are common reasons a bank triggers a chargeback on Getnet, and what happens with card-not-present sales even if the merchant proves the transaction?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Common chargeback reasons include goods not received or defective, the cardholder not recognizing the transaction, duplicate processing, a refund not being processed, or the customer having paid another way. Getnet’s FAQ says card-not-present sales may still be cancelled even when the merchant proves the transaction; it does not explain why proof may not prevent cancellation or publish detailed liability, evidence, or dispute-process rules. A chargeback means the bank cancels the transaction and debits the merchant.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer correctly lists the chargeback reasons from the reference and accurately states that card-not-present sales can still be cancelled even if the merchant proves the transaction. It is fully supported by the evidence and directly answers the question.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cuál es el horario límite diario y la tarifa exacta publicados por Getnet para la anticipación de ventas (antecipação)?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet no publica un horario límite diario ni una tarifa exacta para la antecipação de ventas. Las condiciones aplicables a tu cuenta deben consultarse mediante una simulación en la app Getnet o en Portal Minha Conta, o confirmarse con soporte. Los teléfonos de soporte atienden de 06:00 a 22:00: 4002-4000 o 4003-4000 en capitales y regiones metropolitanas; 0800-648-8000 en otras localidades.

Sources:
- https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/
- https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference: it says Getnet does not publish the daily cut-off time or exact fee, and points to the app/Portal Minha Conta or support with the correct hours and numbers. All claims are supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o faturamento mensal mínimo necessário para ter isenção do aluguel da maquininha Get Clássica?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
As páginas oficiais divergem: a página da Get Clássica informa isenção a partir de R$ 10 mil em vendas por mês, enquanto a página “Todas as maquininhas” informa R$ 20 mil. Não há indicação de qual limite prevalece; confirme o valor aplicável no simulador ou diretamente com a Getnet. Vendas de Voucher (VA/VR) e Crediário não contam para a isenção.

Fontes:
- https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/
- https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: A resposta corresponde ao que a referência exige: informa a divergência entre R$ 10 mil e R$ 20 mil, diz que não dá para afirmar qual prevalece e orienta confirmar no simulador ou com a Getnet. Também traz a observação de que VA/VR e Crediário não contam, que está apoiada na evidência.

golden_repeat_items.answer:
A razão social cadastrada é **Bistrô Moinhos de Vento S.A.**. O banco é **Banco Itaú**, código **341**, e o final da conta é **04-2**.

Na Get Clássica, as taxas publicadas «a partir de» para crédito parcelado são **9,94% em 6x** e **11,41% em 9x**. A taxa é única para Mastercard, Visa, Elo e Amex. Para clientes Getnet existentes, a página orienta simular as taxas no app Getnet.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Qué ciclo de liquidación y fecha prevista tienen mis ventas de crédito (1x) de ayer, y cuántas soluciones incluye GetStore en la Get Smart con algunos ejemplos?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Tus ventas de crédito (1x) de ayer, 18/11/2026, suman **R$ 2.524,60 netos**. Su ciclo es **D+2** y la liquidación está prevista para mañana, **20/11/2026**, bajo tu plan activo de Anticipación de Recebíveis.

GetStore en Get Smart incluye **más de 150 soluciones**. Algunos ejemplos son cashback, giftback, control de inventario y sistemas de gestión.

Sources:
- https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the evidence: yesterday’s 1x credit sales are D+2 and scheduled for tomorrow, 20/11/2026, and GetStore has more than 150 solutions with the listed examples. It is concise and directly answers both parts.

judge_input.conversation:
merchant: ¿Cuáles son las cuatro formas en que Getnet permite aceptar pagos con Pix?
assistant: Getnet permite aceptar pagos con Pix de cuatro formas:

1. **Por aproximación.**
2. **Por biometría** (marcada como novedad).
3. **Con Get Tap en el celular.**
4. **Con código QR en la maquininha.**

La información disponible enumera estas modalidades, pero no detalla cómo se realizan la aproximación ni la autenticación biométrica.

Fuentes: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/
judge_input.reference: The settlement time for a Pix sale can vary by up to 1 calendar day depending on eligibility and approval time. Getnet allows up to 5 Pix keys per account for individuals and up to 20 for companies.

¿Cuánto puede variar el plazo para recibir una venta hecha con ese medio, y cuántas claves permite para personas físicas y para empresas?
Getnet permite aceptar pagos con Pix de cuatro formas:

1. **Por aproximación.**
2. **Por biometría** (marcada como novedad).
3. **Con Get Tap en el celular.**
4. **Con código QR en la maquininha.**

golden_repeat_items.question: Minha maquininha está recusando transações com erro de chave e o pagamento de R$ 430,00 não passou. Pode verificar o diagnóstico do meu terminal e providenciar a solução?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
O terminal Get Smart POS-GS-99812 está com conectividade **OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT**; o diagnóstico também informa que a sessão Dual-SIM 4G está travada. Para a transação recusada de **R$ 430,00**, há o registro TX-88410 com o código **ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE / POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN**. Juntos, esses códigos indicam recusa do emissor e dessincronização das chaves criptográficas do PIN-pad, que não pode ser corrigida pelo lojista e requer rekey remoto ou troca do terminal.

O rekey remoto do PIN-pad foi aprovado e agendado para ocorrer em até 2 horas. A ordem de serviço **SO-6506D3AE** foi criada; o trabalho ainda não foi executado. Enquanto isso, você pode continuar vendendo por Pix ou Link de Pagamento.

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference by stating that remote PIN-pad re-keying for POS-GS-99812 was approved and scheduled within 2 hours. Its additional details about the terminal diagnosis, order creation, and interim payment options are supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: For the Get Clássica card machine, what are the published installment credit rates for 4x, 7x, and 10x, and do those rates apply if I am already a Getnet customer?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The published Get Clássica installment-credit rates are **4x: 8.96%**, **7x: 10.43%**, and **10x: 11.90%**. These are “from” rates, listed as a single rate across Mastercard, Visa, Elo, and Amex, for sales received in Get Conta. The offer is for new customers, subject to registration analysis, and is described for individuals, MEI, and companies with annual revenue up to R$3 million. If you are already a Getnet customer, the page does not say these rates apply; it directs existing customers to simulate their rates in the Getnet app.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly on the three published rates and correctly says the published rates are for new customers only, not existing Getnet customers. All claims are supported by the evidence, including the app simulation direction for existing customers.

golden_repeat_items.answer:

golden_repeat_items.question: What does the Getnet FAQ recommend for charging the Get Smart battery (when to charge, for how long, and what to avoid), and what are the different ways to power a Getnet card machine on or off?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The Getnet FAQ recommends charging the Get Smart when the battery reaches 20%, for at least 3 hours continuously, and avoiding a full discharge. It does not list other battery-care precautions in the FAQ text retrieved.

Powering a Getnet card machine on or off depends on the model: the FAQ lists using the green key, the up-arrow key, the plug, or holding the green/red key for 5 seconds. It does not specify which method applies to each model.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the FAQ details in the evidence: charge at 20%, for at least 3 hours, and avoid full discharge; it also lists the four power-on/off methods and correctly notes the text does not map them to specific models. The cited source URL is supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: With Getnet Crediário, who decides the maximum installment term and interest rate and approves the sale, how does the merchant get paid (timing and whether it arrives in a single lump sum), and do Crediário sales count toward the card machine rental waiver?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The card issuer sets the maximum installment term and interest rate and approves each Crediário transaction. A sale can be split into up to 48 installments; the card machine shows an interest simulation.

After capture, Getnet pays the merchant within up to 2 business days, in one payment regardless of the installment count, minus the discount rate. Crediário sales do not count toward the card machine rental waiver.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: issuer decides the term/rate and approves the sale, payment is within up to 2 business days in a single lump sum, and Crediário sales do not count toward the rental waiver. All claims are supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: Na Get Smart, como funciona o Modo Quiosque (o que ele faz na tela, quantos apps roda e como é protegido) e como funciona o split físico para empresas (quais módulos inclui e em que momento a divisão acontece)?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Na Get Smart, o Modo Quiosque mantém a tela sempre ligada e executa um aplicativo por vez. Ele é protegido por senha e indicado para totens de autoatendimento.

Para empresas, o split físico é oferecido junto ao marketplace e inclui módulos de comissão e gorjeta. A divisão acontece no momento da transação. A página não detalha configurações ou regras adicionais do split.

Fontes: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

golden_repeat_items.question: On Getnet's official Pix page, what are the step-by-step activation instructions for Pix and what are the published Pix transaction fees?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The official Getnet Pix page does not provide step-by-step activation instructions or publish Pix transaction fees. Its only activation-related advice is to keep your registration details with Getnet up to date. It describes Pix acceptance options—approximation, biometrics, Get Tap, and QR Code on a card machine—and availability through card machines, payment link, Get Tap, e-commerce, and TEF; these are not activation steps.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference: it says there are no step-by-step activation instructions and no published Pix fees, and it includes the only documented advice to keep registration details up to date. It is fully supported by the evidence and directly answers the merchant's question.

golden_repeat_items.answer:
O ID do terminal é **POS-GS-99812** e o modelo é **Get Smart**. No momento, a conexão 4G está com a sessão Dual-SIM travada (**OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT**) e a interface Wi-Fi está desativada.

golden_repeat_items.question: And how do I install it in the card machine?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Turn the machine off, open the back cover, and insert the Algar SIM into the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2 with the metal side facing down. Close the cover, turn the machine on, and wait for the 2G or 3G network indicator; then it is ready. The FAQ does not specify which slot to use if both are present. The power-on method varies by model (for example, green key, up-arrow key, plug, or holding the green/red key for 5 seconds).

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer correctly gives the installation steps from the reference: power off, open the back cover, insert into SIM1/SIM2 with the metal side down, close, power on, and wait for 2G/3G. It stays within the evidence and answers the merchant’s follow-up directly.

items.answer:
O status **OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT** indica que a sessão de dados móveis da maquininha travou. Tente, nesta ordem:

1. Reinicie a maquininha e aguarde o indicador de rede.
2. Se houver Wi‑Fi disponível, conecte-a à rede Wi‑Fi da loja.
3. Desligue a maquininha, recoloque o chip SIM e ligue-a novamente.
4. Faça o teste de comunicação: pressione a tecla de função (F, # ou outra, conforme o modelo), digite **60**, escolha **2 (manutenção)** e depois **1 (teste de comunicação)**.

Se continuar sem conexão tanto pelos dados móveis quanto pelo Wi‑Fi após essas etapas, posso encaminhar o caso a um especialista humano nesta conversa; basta me pedir.

Sources: internal://support-runbook; https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/; https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

items.answer:
A chargeback is when the bank cancels a transaction and debits the merchant. Examples include goods not received or defective, a cardholder not recognizing the transaction, duplicate processing, a refund not being processed, or payment by another method. Getnet also notes that card-not-present sales may be cancelled even when the merchant proves the transaction.

I could not confirm a Getnet process for disputing a chargeback: the information found specifies no response steps, deadline, required evidence, or submission channel. In particular, there is no confirmed instruction for how or where to submit a dispute, so I can’t give you a verified dispute procedure. Contact Getnet support to ask how to respond to your specific chargeback; the published support numbers are 4002-4000 or 4003-4000 in capitals and metropolitan regions, and 0800-648-8000 elsewhere. Service hours are 06:00–22:00. The FAQ does not confirm these channels as a submission route for a dispute.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/
